_comment: Docker/single-container variant of servers.json: the same 4 MCP servers, launched as stdio subprocesses of the API process instead of standalone HTTP services. Selected by setting API_SERVERS_PATH to this file's path (done in the root Dockerfile's ENV). Each server still reads its own settings (DB_MCP_DATABASE_URL, CODE_MCP_*, etc.) from the environment exactly as it does in HTTP mode — only the transport changes, via MCP_TRANSPORT=stdio below.
